objects.description: [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has gathered hardware IDs (HWIDs) regarding the victim machine.(Citation: Unit42_Vidar_July2026) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has used `GetEnvironmentStringsW` and `GetModuleHandleExW` to gather information about the victim machine.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has collected OS data from the victim machine.(Citation: QuorumCyber_Vidar_March2023)(Citation: Logpoint_StealerMalwareFamilies_2024)
